compute_retrieval_metrics: compute retrieval metrics R1, R5, R10, and median rank from a similarity matrix using RetrievalMetric
compute_didemo_metrics: compute DiDeMo moment localization metrics rank1, rank5, and mean IoU from predicted video segments
compute_nlg_metrics: compute NLG evaluation metrics including BLEU, METEOR, ROUGE, and CIDEr from NLGEval using NLGMetric
compute_action_recognition_metrics: compute action recognition accuracy and recall splits from video embeddings and labels using ActionRecognitionMetric
compute_cross_task_recall: compute per-task and average recall for cross-task predictions using CrossTaskMetric
